## Definition of Done
- [ ] Every acceptance criterion is met and ticked in the issue
- [ ] Reviewed and approved by someone other than the author
- [ ] Automated tests added or updated, and CI passes
- [ ] Verification done: user flow tried manually, including one edge case
- [ ] Side effects checked: does this affect reminders, schedules or cancellations?
- [ ] README or runbook updated if behaviour changed
